0x000855.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00094E.en: 「Dammit!@　I won't go down next time!」

0x000A77.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AAF.en: 「Well now...@　that's just not a good look, is it!」

0x000B78.en: 「Ugh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000BB3.en: 「Like hell I'd botch it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000C07.en: 「Messed up...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D58.en: 「This is it... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000DC6.en: 「Grrgh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000E04.en: 「It's no good, too much damage... I'm retreating!」

0x000E51.en: 「Well, I'm beat. The rest is up to you.」

0x000E8F.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000ED6.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F81.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the shooting star this time... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010BD.en: 「Ugh...gah! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001171.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x0011A6.en: 「Damn! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x001263.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x001292.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a long way to go...!」

0x0012E0.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001359.en: 「Sorry, everyone!@ I'm gonna have to pull out...!」

0x0013CA.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001408.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001437.en: 「I can't go on. Please excuse me.」

0x0014C2.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001628.en: 「I'll eject now...@ Ngh...! Not a good look at all...」

0x0016E6.en: 「Gaaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001855.en: 「So I've still got much to learn...!」

0x0018F8.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x0019D0.en: 「Yes. We intercepted a transmission from a nearby unit, but...@ the reports are contradictory. We can't confirm if it's true.」

0x001A62.en: 「Even trying to get word from Central,@ the disturbance in the ether flow keeps blocking us...」

0x001AD9.en: 「If they really did clash...@ which side do you think started it?」

0x001B35.en: 「Can't say yet.@ Kirkus's army had deployed units on every front@ to pursue Shutedonias, but...」

0x001BD1.en: 「Even if Feil's forces struck at that opening@ against Kirkus's main body,@ the timing still doesn't add up.」

0x001C70.en: 「Because if civil war broke out now...@ it would hand Shutedonias@ the perfect opportunity.」

0x001CF1.en: 「Could it be Kirkus's forces@ that struck at Feil's...?」

0x001D4A.en: 「General Kirkus backs Prince Terius, and...@ I don't see why he'd turn on Prince Feil,@ who already ceded the throne...」

0x001DEF.en: 「Unless he means to use this chance to get rid of Feil before he becomes a problem.@ But if he did that, Kirkus would be the villain.」

0x001EA9.en: 「Unconfirmed, but there's word that General Kirkus was routed@ and issued an order to surrender.」

0x001F64.en: 「Is there nothing we can do@ about the ether flow disturbance?」

0x001FD0.en: 「For it to be this unstable is rare.@ It's possible there's some connection@ to Volkruss.」

0x002072.en: 「Either way,@ the disrupted comms are only fueling the confusion.」

0x0020C8.en: 「All we can do is get closer to Central@ and gather accurate intel with our own eyes and ears...」

0x002179.en: 「Kirkus's unit is turning to two o'clock! They're breaking off!」

0x0021CF.en: 「Noticed us and ran, did they? How suspicious.」

0x002247.en: 「Kirkus's unit has stopped! They're coming about!」

0x002281.en: 「All stop, hold TD at current altitude!@ All units, launch!」

0x00230B.en: 「Then that means General Kirkus is aboard it!?」

0x002354.en: 「Both the mobile fortress and the Masoukishin@ have taken heavy damage.」

0x0023AA.en: 「So the report that General Kirkus was routed@ was true after all?」

0x00247A.en: 「I...will fight alongside Lune and the others.@ Unless you change your heart, Father.」

0x0024DF.en: 「I see... Then I sever the bond between us as father and son.@ If you insist on standing in my way to the end...@ I will show you no mercy.」

0x00259A.en: 「General Kirkus...@ was the enemy you fought Feil's forces?」

0x0025F6.en: 「That's right. The Masoukishin Cybuster, Gaddess...@ and the Hagane's unit.」

0x00266E.en: 「Everyone on the Hagane, fighting for Feil's side...!?」

0x0026E2.en: 「Heh, hehe... And look at me now.@ The power of the Masoukishin is not to be underestimated...@ nor are the warriors of the Hagane.」

0x0027B2.en: 「And what will you do if you know?」

0x0027DA.en: 「Ha, can't answer, can you?@ Then it was you who started it.@ Had something to hide, no doubt?」

0x002889.en: 「We'll hear the details later.@ To start a civil war just as the fight with Shutedonias@ is finally ending... it's outrageous.」

0x00299D.en: 「Having come this far,@ there is no turning back.」

0x0029E7.en: 「And the soldiers dragged into it@ don't deserve any of this!」

0x002A3D.en: 「Do you mean to turn all the people who gathered under you@ for Langran's liberation into traitors!?」

0x002AC0.en: 「...I've ordered my men to surrender to Feil's forces.@ Even so, there are still those@ who choose to follow me...」

0x002B62.en: 「With so little strength, how do you intend@ to unify La Gias?」

0x002BF9.en: 「...Sorry to keep you waiting, Lord Kirkus.」

0x002C4C.en: 「Leave this to me, and go on to that place.」

0x002CA2.en: 「General Kirkus!@ You've joined hands with the likes of Louzorl!?」

0x002CFB.en: 「Your method for unifying Langran, don't tell me...!?」

0x002D38.en: 「Power, Yang Long, Zashford.@ To forge an era, you need power like the Masoukishin's...@ no, power beyond even that.」

0x002DD4.en: 「Madness!@ You know what Louzorl and his kind are after!@ You're only being used by him!」

0x002E6A.en: 「We are using each other, you see.@ Now, Lord Kirkus... hurry and withdraw.」

0x002F10.en: 「Now then...@ shall we keep each other company a while?」

0x002F94.en: 「That's not all.@ Since then, I've succeeded in reviving@ a fragment of Lord Volkruss...」

0x003037.en: 「You shall all become@ offerings to it.」

0x00314B.en: 「To be precise, only a part of it, but...@ once my god awakens, there is no stopping it.@ It will destroy without limit.」

0x0031D8.en: 「These fragments have no intellect.@ They act on destructive impulse alone.」

0x003240.en: 「A-and you call something like that a god...!」

0x00329F.en: 「The one thing equal to all creation is death alone.@ Receive this supreme and absolute truth.」

0x003310.en: 「There's no way using a monster like that@ could ever bring peace to La Gias!」

0x003381.en: 「Worse, it could destroy everything.@ Does General Kirkus truly believe@ he can control Volkruss...!?」

0x00342F.en: 「The longer Langran's chaos drags on,@ the easier it is for us to operate.」

0x003497.en: 「Besides, the grudges and grief of the dying@ make fine offerings to Lord Volkruss.」

0x00350B.en: 「Now then, may Lord Volkruss's salvation@ come upon you all...」

0x0035A1.en: 「Th-the god of destruction, Volkruss...!@ Can we even beat something like that...!?」

0x003600.en: 「Get a grip, Zashford!@ God of destruction or not, those things are@ just dead copies, right!?」

0x003696.en: 「We fought a whole army of monsters@ called the <Einst> up on the surface!@ We're not gonna be scared!」

0x00372B.en: 「We finally know where the Hagane's crew is,@ so there's no way we can lose here!」

0x0037A2.en: 「All units, commence attack!@ Annihilate the fragments of Volkruss!」

0x0037FB.en: 「All enemy signals within the combat zone have vanished!」

0x003835.en: 「Learning where the Hagane went is fortunate,@ but leaving General Kirkus be is dangerous.」

0x0038B2.en: 「Colonel Lefina, let's pursue the General.@ We have to stop him here.」

0x00392C.en: 「Understood.@ This ship will now pursue General Kirkus.」

0x003985.en: 「So that's Volkruss...@ what a vile Prana...!」

0x0039DE.en: 「Using something like that...@ no matter how I look at it, Father's way is wrong!」

0x003A49.en: 「General Kirkus... so to achieve his ambition,@ he truly will stop at nothing!」

0x003AC6.en: 「Honestly, what part of a monster like that@ is supposed to be a god!」

0x003B19.en: 「Volkruss... with the sword of exorcism, I'll cut you down!」

0x003B5F.en: 「Don't think a monster or two@ is enough to stop us!」

0x003BC4.en: 「An evil god that harms people, huh.@ In a way, easier to read than humans who preach.」

0x003C29.en: 「We can't let a monster like that run loose!」

0x003C69.en: 「Volkruss...@　I've no intention of becoming your sacrifice.」

0x003CBC.en: 「Golems, and now a dark god!@　This is starting to feel more and more@　like some fantasy epic!」

0x003D31.en: 「So that's the dark god Volkruss... Still, I won't back down!」

0x003D7D.en: 「If there are this many of the same thing...@　they must self-replicate or regenerate!?」

0x003DF4.en: 「Heh, now that's the face of a proper dark god!@　I'll wipe you out right here and now!」
